skills.name: Attack Boost
skills.description: Increases attack power.

skills.name: Agitator
skills.description:
Increases attack power and
affinity when large monsters
become enraged.

skills.name: Peak Performance
skills.description:
Increases attack when
your health is full.

skills.name: Resentment
skills.description:
Increases attack when you have
recoverable damage (the red
portion of your health gauge).

skills.name: Resuscitate
skills.description:
Increases attack power when you are
suffering from an abnormal status.

skills.name: Critical Eye
skills.description: Increases affinity.

skills.name: Critical Boost
skills.description:
Increases the damage of
critical hits.

skills.name: Weakness Exploit
skills.description:
Increases the affinity of attacks
that exploit a monster weak spot.

skills.name: Latent Power
skills.description:
Temporarily increases affinity and
reduces stamina depletion when
certain conditions are met.

skills.name: Maximum Might
skills.description:
Increases affinity if stamina
is kept full for a period of time.

skills.name: Critical Element
skills.description:
Increases elemental damage
(fire, water, thunder, ice, dragon)
when landing critical hits.

skills.name: Master's Touch
skills.description:
Prevents your weapon from losing
sharpness during critical hits.

skills.name: Fire Attack
skills.description:
Increases fire element attack
power. (Elemental attack power has
a maximum limit.)

skills.name: Water Attack
skills.description:
Increases water element attack
power. (Elemental attack power has
a maximum limit.)

skills.name: Ice Attack
skills.description:
Increases ice element attack
power. (Elemental attack power has
a maximum limit.)

skills.name: Thunder Attack
skills.description:
Increases thunder element attack
power. (Elemental attack power has
a maximum limit.)

skills.name: Dragon Attack
skills.description:
Increases dragon element attack
power. (Elemental attack power has
a maximum limit.)

skills.name: Poison Attack
skills.description:
Increases the rate of poison buildup.
(Poison buildup has a maximum
limit.)

skills.name: Paralysis Attack
skills.description:
Increases the rate of paralysis buildup.
(Paralysis buildup has a maximum
limit.)

skills.name: Sleep Attack
skills.description:
Increases the rate of sleep buildup.
(Sleep buildup has a maximum
limit.)

skills.name: Blast Attack
skills.description:
Increases the rate of blast buildup.
(Blast buildup has a maximum
limit.)

skills.name: Handicraft
skills.description:
Extends the weapon sharpness gauge.
However, it will not increase the
gauge past its maximum.

skills.name: Razor Sharp
skills.description:
Prevents your weapon from
losing sharpness.

skills.name: Spare Shot
skills.description:
Bow and bowgun shots have a chance
not to expend coatings or ammo.

skills.name: Protective Polish
skills.description:
Weapon sharpness does not decrease
for a set time after sharpening.

skills.name: Mind's Eye
skills.description:
Your attacks are deflected less and
deal more damage to hard targets.

skills.name: Ballistics
skills.description:
Extends the range in which
ammo and arrows have
maximum power.

skills.name: Bludgeoner
skills.description:
Increases attack power when your
weapon sharpness is low.

skills.name: Bow Charge Plus
skills.description:
Increases max bow charge level
by one.

skills.name: Focus
skills.description:
Increases the fill rate for weapons
with gauges and the charge rate
for weapons with charge attacks.

skills.name: Power Prolonger
skills.description:
Long swords, dual blades, insect
glaives, switch axes, and charge
blades stay powered up longer.

skills.name: Marathon Runner
skills.description:
Slows down stamina depletion
for actions which continuously
drain stamina (such as dashing).

skills.name: Constitution
skills.description:
Reduces stamina depletion
when evading, blocking, or
doing certain other actions.

skills.name: Stamina Surge
skills.description: Speeds up stamina recovery.

skills.name: Guard
skills.description:
Reduces knockbacks and stamina
depletion when guarding.

skills.name: Guard Up
skills.description:
Allows you to guard against
ordinarily unblockable attacks.

skills.name: Offensive Guard
skills.description:
Temporarily increases attack power
after executing a perfectly-timed
guard.

skills.name: Critical Draw
skills.description:
Increases affinity for a short time
after performing a draw attack.
(Does not include Silkbind attacks.)

skills.name: Punishing Draw
skills.description:
Adds a stun effect to draw attacks
and slightly increases attack power.
(Does not include Silkbind attacks.)

skills.name: Quick Sheathe
skills.description: Speeds up weapon sheathing.

skills.name: Slugger
skills.description: Makes it easier to stun monsters.

skills.name: Stamina Thief
skills.description:
Increases certain attacks'
ability to exhaust monsters.

skills.name: Affinity Sliding
skills.description:
Sliding increases your affinity
for a short time.

skills.name: Horn Maestro
skills.description:
Increases overall performance speed
and shockwave damage.

skills.name: Artillery
skills.description:
Strengthens explosive attacks like
shells, Wyvern's Fire, charge blade
phial attacks, and Sticky Ammo.

skills.name: Load Shells
skills.description:
Improves reloading, and increases
the gunlance's shell capacity and
charge blade's phial capacity.

skills.name: Special Ammo Boost
skills.description:
Increases the power of bowgun
special ammo and Dragon Piercer.

skills.name: Normal/Rapid Up
skills.description:
Increases the attack power
of Normal Ammo and
Rapid-type arrows.

skills.name: Pierce Up
skills.description:
Increases the attack
power of Piercing Ammo
and Piercing-type arrows.

skills.name: Spread Up
skills.description:
Increases the attack power
of Spread Ammo and Spread-
type arrows

skills.name: Ammo Up
skills.description:
Increases bowgun loading capacity.
(There is a cap to loading capacity.)

skills.name: Reload Speed
skills.description:
Increases bowgun reloading and
bow coating loading speed.

skills.name: Recoil Down
skills.description:
Reduces recoil when firing
bowgun ammo.

skills.name: Steadiness
skills.description:
Suppresses the deviation
of bowgun shots.

skills.name: Rapid Fire Up
skills.description: Improves light bowgun rapid fire.

skills.name: Defense Boost
skills.description:
Increases defense. Resistances
will also improve as the level
increases.

skills.name: Divine Blessing
skills.description:
Has a predetermined chance of
reducing the damage you take.

skills.name: Recovery Up
skills.description:
Increases the amount recovered
when restoring health.

skills.name: Recovery Speed
skills.description:
Speeds healing of recoverable
damage (the red portion of the
health gauge).

skills.name: Speed Eating
skills.description:
Increases meat-eating and
item-consumption speed.

skills.name: Earplugs
skills.description:
Grants protection from
large monsters' roars.

skills.name: Windproof
skills.description:
Grants protection against wind
pressure.

skills.name: Tremor Resistance
skills.description:
Grants protection against ground
tremors.

skills.name: Bubbly Dance
skills.description:
Reduces bubbleblight and grants
increased evasion when afflicted.

skills.name: Evade Window
skills.description:
Extends the invulnerability
period when evading.

skills.name: Evade Extender
skills.description: Increases evade distance.

skills.name: Fire Resistance
skills.description:
Increases fire resistance.
Also improves defense at
higher levels.

skills.name: Water Resistance
skills.description:
Increases water resistance.
Also improves defense at
higher levels.

skills.name: Ice Resistance
skills.description:
Increases ice resistance.
Also improves defense at
higher levels.

skills.name: Thunder Resistance
skills.description:
Increases thunder resistance.
Also improves defense at
higher levels.

skills.name: Dragon Resistance
skills.description:
Increases dragon resistance.
Also improves defense at
higher levels.

skills.name: Blight Resistance
skills.description:
Grants protection against all
elemental blights.

skills.name: Poison Resistance
skills.description: Reduces damage while poisoned.

skills.name: Paralysis Resistance
skills.description: Reduces the duration of paralysis.

skills.name: Sleep Resistance
skills.description: Reduces the duration of sleep.

skills.name: Stun Resistance
skills.description: Reduces stun duration.

skills.name: Muck Resistance
skills.description:
Reduces impairments to mobility
while stuck in monster muck or
deep snow.

skills.name: Blast Resistance
skills.description: Grants protection against blastblight.

skills.name: Botanist
skills.description:
Increases the quantity of herbs and
other consumable items you gather.

skills.name: Geologist
skills.description:
Increases the number of times
you can use a gathering point.

skills.name: Partbreaker
skills.description:
Makes it easier to break
or sever parts of monsters.

skills.name: Capture Master
skills.description:
High chance of increased capture
rewards. (No effect when joining
mid-quest.)

skills.name: Carving Master
skills.description:
Lets you carve one additional time.
(No effect when joining mid-quest.)

skills.name: Good Luck
skills.description:
Good chance of increased quest
rewards. (No effect when joining
mid-quest.)

skills.name: Speed Sharpening
skills.description:
Speeds up weapon sharpening
when using a whetstone.

skills.name: Bombardier
skills.description:
Increases the damage
of explosive items.

skills.name: Mushroomancer
skills.description:
Lets you digest mushrooms that
would otherwise be inedible and
gain their advantageous effects.

skills.name: Item Prolonger
skills.description:
Extends the duration
of some item effects.

skills.name: Wide-Range
skills.description:
Allows the effects of certain
items to also affect nearby allies.

skills.name: Free Meal
skills.description:
Gives you a predetermined
chance of consuming a food
or drink item for free.

skills.name: Heroics
skills.description:
Increases attack power and defense
when health drops to 35% or lower.

skills.name: Fortify
skills.description:
Increases your attack and defense
when you fall in battle.
(Disabled for some quests. Can be
activated twice.)

skills.name: Flinch Free
skills.description:
Prevents knockbacks and other
reactions to small damage.

skills.name: Jump Master
skills.description:
Prevents attacks from knocking
you back during a jump.

skills.name: Carving Pro
skills.description:
Prevents knockback from
attacks while carving.

skills.name: Hunger Resistance
skills.description:
Reduces maximum stamina
depletion over time.

skills.name: Leap of Faith
skills.description:
Allows you to do a dive-evade when
facing towards large monsters, and
extends the dive-evade distance.

skills.name: Diversion
skills.description:
Increases the attention drawn
when attacking a monster.

skills.name: Master Mounter
skills.description: Improves your Wyvern Riding skills.

skills.name: Chameleos Blessing
skills.description:
Gain the power of the elder dragon
Chameleos.

skills.name: Kushala Blessing
skills.description:
Gain the power of the elder dragon
Kushala Daora.

skills.name: Teostra Blessing
skills.description:
Gain the power of the elder dragon
Teostra.

skills.name: Dragonheart
skills.description:
Draconic energy fills you after
losing a certain amount of health.
Weapons lose all non-dragon effects.

skills.name: Wirebug Whisperer
skills.description: Improves your handling of Wirebugs.

skills.name: Wall Runner
skills.description:
Reduces stamina consumption
when running on walls.

skills.name: Counterstrike
skills.description:
Temporarily increases attack
power after being knocked back.

skills.name: Rapid Morph
skills.description:
Increases switch speed and power
for switch axes and charge blades.

skills.name: Hellfire Cloak
skills.description:
Grants hellfire resistance and
confers explosive hellfire power
to your attacks after fulfilling
certain conditions.

skills.name: Wind Alignment
skills.description:
Gain the power of the elder dragon
Wind Serpent Ibushi.

skills.name: Thunder Alignment
skills.description:
Gain the power of the elder dragon
Thunder Serpent Narwa.

skills.name: Stormsoul
skills.description:
Strengthens thunder and dragon
power and improves skills of the
same elements.

skills.name: Blood Rite
skills.description:
A proportion of damage dealt is
converted to health when striking
a broken monster part.

skills.name: Dereliction
skills.description:
Qurio will drain health, but also bolster
your attacks. Multiple Qurio further
bolster attacks and let you recover health
when performing a Switch Skill Swap.

skills.name: Furious
skills.description:
Using the Red Scroll builds your fury
while fighting monsters. Swapping to
the Blue Scroll when your fury is full
gives you infinite stamina temporarily.

skills.name: Mail of Hellfire
skills.description:
Decreases defense but increases
attack. Exact changes to stats
depends on Switch Skill Swap
Scroll that is being used.

skills.name: Coalescence
skills.description:
Temporarily enhances attacks
after recovering from blights
or abnormal status.

skills.name: Bloodlust
skills.description:
The effects of the Frenzy virus change.
Health is gradually reduced, but you
gain a variety of effects. Frenzy virus
occurs regularly when in combat.

skills.name: Defiance
skills.description:
Increases defense when
large monsters become
enraged.

skills.name: Sneak Attack
skills.description:
Increases damage to large
monsters when attacks hit
them from behind.

skills.name: Adrenaline Rush
skills.description:
Perform a perfectly-timed
evade just as a monster
attacks for a temporary
attack boost.

skills.name: Redirection
skills.description:
Perform a perfectly-timed Switch
Skill Swap just as a monster
attacks to reduce the damage
and negate damage reactions.

skills.name: Spiribird's Call
skills.description:
Receive the effects of a random
Spiribird at fixed intervals.
(Certain quests only)

skills.name: Charge Master
skills.description:
When a charged attack hits
a monster, the element and
status buildup of the charged
attack increases.

skills.name: Foray
skills.description:
Increases attack power and affinity
when attacking a large monster
affected by poison, paralysis,
or an elemental blight.

skills.name: Tune-Up
skills.description:
Increases the stats of custom
mods attached to bowguns.

skills.name: Grinder (S)
skills.description:
When recovering sharpness,
grants a boost to sharpness
properties based on the number
of levels recovered.

skills.name: Bladescale Hone
skills.description:
Dodge rolling to evade an attack with
your weapon drawn will recover sharpness,
refill bowgun ammo, or give Close-range
Coatings a temporary boost.

skills.name: Wall Runner (Boost)
skills.description:
Wirebug Gauge recovers faster
while wall running.

skills.name: Quick Breath
skills.description:
You can remove some statuses
or slow their effects by performing
a Switch Skill Swap. Health
recovers when a status is removed.

skills.name: Element Exploit
skills.description:
Increases elemental damage when
attacking body parts upon which
the element are highly effective.

skills.name: Burst
skills.description:
Continuously landing hits gradually
increases attack and elemental
attack. (The amount of increase
depends on the weapon.)

skills.name: Guts
skills.description:
Prevents fainting one time only
when damage taken exceeds
a certain amount of your
remaining health.

skills.name: Status Trigger
skills.description:
Perform a perfectly-timed evade just
as a monster attacks to trigger
abnormal status buildup on hit.

skills.name: Intrepid Heart
skills.description:
After filling the gauge by continuously
landing attacks, negates damage reactions
and reduces damage taken from a single
attack that would knock you back.

skills.name: Buildup Boost
skills.description:
Increases attack power when you
land attacks that build poison,
paralysis, sleep, blast, or exhaust.
(Exhaust - ammo/phials/coatings only)

skills.name: Embolden
skills.description:
When targeted by a monster,
that monster becomes more
likely to become enraged but
your own defense is increased.

skills.name: Wind Mantle
skills.description:
Using Silkbind attacks boosts Wirebug
Gauge recovery. Landing continuous
attacks increases the effect. Wears off
when you sheathe your weapon.

skills.name: Powder Mantle
skills.description:
Continuously attacking a large
monster will cause powder to form
around you. The color and effects
of the powder will change over time.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.description:
Switch to the Blue Swap Scroll and
all vitality will change to red gauge
and start decreasing. As long as
you have red you cannot faint.

skills.name: Strife
skills.description:
Increases elemental attack and
affinity in proportion to the length
of your red health gauge.

skills.name: Frostcraft
skills.description:
An aura of frost builds when your
weapon is sheathed, raising attack.
The effect decreases with each
melee hit or shot/arrow fired.

skills.name: Dragon Conversion
skills.description:
When using the Red Swap Scroll, all
elemental resistance is set to 0 and
converted into elemental attack. The Blue
Swap Scroll raises elemental resistance.

skills.name: Heaven-Sent
skills.description:
Activates when not taking damage for a
while during combat with a large monster.
The effect is lost when you are knocked back
or stray too far away from the monster.

skills.name: Frenzied Bloodlust
skills.description:
Temporarily gain an additional Wirebug
when overcoming the Frenzy. The effect
duration decreases drastically when your
weapon is sheathed.

skills.name: Blood Awakening
skills.description:
Gradually bolsters your attacks for
a certain period of time, depending
on how much health you regain
when landing attacks.

skills.name: Shock Absorber
skills.description:
Disables damage reactions when you
hit a friend or when a friend hits you.
(Does not apply during certain status
ailments.)

skills.name: Inspiration
skills.description:
Adds an extra attack increase bonus
for a short while when activating
effects that affect friends within a
certain target area, like melodies, etc.
